meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 22 (DECISIONS 044, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new HP/HyperX models, 13 quotes, 1 identifier verified (Cloud III S Wireless Black-Red), 4 stay pending (see catalog notes). HP official US store sweep 2026-11-06 (BUILD_LOG 059): hp.com/us-en product pages confirm model identity, MPNs and prices in page JSON-LD (all five InStock at the sweep prices; QuadCast 2 S $149.99 sale confirmed fresh — a 5-day-old index read showing $159.99 was stale). Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{hp-omen-27k,hyperx-omen-oled-27q,hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless,hyperx-pulsefire-haste-2-pro,hyperx-quadcast-2-s}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~19:49-19:51 UTC (11:49-11:51 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. Black Friday sale prices (OMEN OLED 27q $399.99 vs $499.99 list, QuadCast 2 S $149.99 vs $199.99 list) should be re-checked after the event ends Nov 8. One new category enters the set with this batch: microphones (QuadCast 2 S is the first microphone; category decision recorded in DECISIONS 044). No Amazon touch: no Amazon quotes, no Amazon-sourced identifiers (the OMEN OLED 27q UPC 199642944428 is stated on Amazon only and conflicts with the HP datasheet code 199642944442 — neither was recorded; the QuadCast 2 S UPC 197961186741 is stated on Amazon in four regions but its only non-Amazon source is the HP manual, so it stays pending).
